title: TransferRequestSummary
description: Summary of a transfer request. This resource includes only global information of the request. There is no information about the lines details here. The globalAmount property is a free of charge amount.

transferRequestId.description: Identifier related to the transfer request

globalAmount.description: Global amount of the transfer request.

transfersCount.description: Number of transfers included in this request.

creationDateTime.description: Date and time of creation for the request.

modificationDateTime.description: Date and time of modification for the request.

globalFee.description: Global fees of the transfer request.

Amount.description: Default objet which stands for an amount (number value + currency code).

currencyCode.description: Alphabetical code of the currency code (ISO 4217)

RequestedTransferRequestDebitMode.title: RequestedTransferRequestDebitMode
RequestedTransferRequestDebitMode.description:
Indicates how the caller wishes the set of transfer request lines to be debited from the source account ; that is if there should be only one global accounting entry with the global amount or alternatively there should be n single transfers (one accounting entry for one transfer request line).
Code Meaning
GROUPED One global accounting entry with the global amount.
SINGLE One accounting entry for each transfer request line.

TransferRequestStatus.title: TransferRequestStatus
TransferRequestStatus.description:
State of the transfer request. This state is useful to follow and manage a transfer request only during the entry phase. Once confirmed, rejected or canceled, the transfer request is in a terminal state and will not change, so that it is the state of the transfer request line one must then examinate to know if a transfer have been well processed or not.
Code Meaning
INITIALIZED The transfer request has been accepted but all transfer lines has not been processed so that the transfer request confirmation step is not yet available.
CONFIRMABLE The transfer request has been accepted and all transfer lines has been processed so that the transfer request confirmation step is available.
CONFIRMED The transfer request has been confirmed. One cannot add additional transfer lines to the transfer request anymore.
REJECTED The BPCE system has rejected all the lines (for a common cause).
DELETED The subscriber has canceled the transfer request (all lines are canceled).
